query: Which of the six cancer risk behaviors should be designated the primary outcome for the pilot and the definitive trial, and what criteria justify that choice?

response.query: Which of the six cancer risk behaviors should be designated the primary outcome for the pilot and the definitive trial, and what criteria justify that choice?
response.answer: Tobacco use should be designated as the primary cancer risk behavior for the pilot and definitive trial due to its high prevalence and significant impact on cancer incidence. This choice is justified by its well-established link to multiple cancers and public health burden.

results.title: The 25 Best Movies of 2025 (So Far)
results.content: There’s no doubt that the first half of 2025 has been an odd time for the movie industry. “art” generation has stepped right in as the latest industry boogeyman, even as films from the likes of *Succession*’s Jesse Armstrong are rushed into production (and release!) in the span of just a few months, to provide real-time satire. At the same time, the power of Gen Z meme culture propelled a film like *A Minecraft Movie* in the direction of the coveted $1 billion box office mark, but this was still only good enough to give that Warner Bros. So yeah, it’s understandable that it can feel as if the natural order of things has been inverted to some degree. That includes excellent festival titles such as the likes of *Twinless* or *The Things You Kill*, *Sentimental Value* or *If I Had Legs I’d Kick You*–these are all titles that you may end up finding on our list at the end of 2025, when more audiences have had a chance to see them.
